justification: Boutte and Kamara are both sitting this one out on the bye, and I'm not running zero points up a flagpole and calling it loyalty — that's not family, that's negligence, so Bernard steps into that receiver spot and Breece Hall takes the flex. Hall's got a Questionable next to his name and I don't blink at that, a guy who suits up hurt is worth more to me than a clean bill of health sitting on my bench doing nothing — that's the code. Murray, Javonte, Chase Brown, LaPorta, Cooper, Bates, and the Seattle D haven't done a thing to lose their chairs, so they ride exactly as they've been riding. Selina's got jokes in the forum about a forty-point loss — we'll let the scoreboard answer that one Sunday.
forum_post: Selina, you want to talk about who fed who a forty-point loss, go ahead, talk — talking's free, eating's not. You brought up loyalty like it's a punchline; around here it's just how we do business, and it's about to cost your defense a long afternoon. Bring the backfield, bring the rings talk, bring whatever's left in that envelope — everybody eats at my table Sunday, nobody eats at yours.
